# Premium Markdown

Convert markdown to **PDF**, **HTML**, and **TXT** instantly.

- Client-side processing
- Fast & secure browser engine
- Live preview as you type

## Quick Start

1. Type or paste Markdown here
2. Pick an export format
3. Click **Download PDF** 

### Checklist

- [x] Headings, lists, and tables
- [x] Syntax-highlighted code
- [x] Mermaid diagrams
- [x] LaTeX / KaTeX math

## Code Example

```javascript
function hello(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}
```

## Tables

| Use case | Why Markdown |
|----------|--------------|
| AI chats | Copy → paste → PDF |
| Resumes | Plain text you can version |
| Reports | Fast structure, clean export |

## Diagram (Mermaid)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Paste Markdown] --> B[Live preview]
  B --> C[Download PDF]
  C --> D[Share]
```

## Math (LaTeX / KaTeX)

Inline math looks like this: $E = mc^2$

Block math equations:

$
\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$

## Nested list

- Structure
  - Headings and paragraphs
  - Bullet, numbered, and task lists
- Media
  - Images and links
  - Blockquotes

> Tip: This editor supports full GitHub Flavored Markdown and renders instantly in your browser!

faq.a1: Yes. PDFWritter is completely free with no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no watermarks, and no account required. You can convert Markdown to PDF, HTML, and TXT, use the live editor, and render Mermaid diagrams without paying or signing up. There is no artificial daily conversion cap for normal browser use, so students, indie developers, and teams can export documentation whenever they need it. If you need help choosing a workflow or reporting a bug, email pdfwritter@gmail.com or reach us via the contact form and Reddit (u/pdfwritter).
faq.q2: Are my files sent to a server?
faq.a2: By default, PDFWritter converts Markdown in your browser so drafts, README files, and internal docs stay on your device. That is the privacy-first path most users want for quick PDF or HTML export without uploading sensitive notes to a third-party converter. For very long documents you can optionally use a configured render server to speed generation — you control when that path is used. We do not sell document contents, and day-to-day editing does not require uploading files to a PDFWritter account. Questions about privacy: pdfwritter@gmail.com.
faq.a3: PDFWritter supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), including headings, bold and italic emphasis, ordered and unordered lists, task lists, tables, fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting, blockquotes, links, and images. That covers typical README files, developer docs, and notes copied from GitHub. Mermaid diagram code fences are also supported in live preview and export. If a specific GFM edge case fails to render, send an example to pdfwritter@gmail.com so we can reproduce it.
faq.q4: Can I use this on mobile?
faq.a4: Yes. PDFWritter is a responsive web app that works on phones and tablets as well as desktop browsers. You can paste Markdown, preview formatting, and export to PDF, HTML, or TXT without installing a native app. On smaller screens the editor and preview stack for readability; on larger screens you get a side-by-side layout. For the most comfortable long-document editing, a tablet or desktop is still ideal, but quick conversions work well on mobile.
faq.q5: What file formats can I export to?
faq.a5: You can export to PDF for sharing and printing, semantic HTML for blogs or CMS paste-in, plain TXT when you need unformatted text, and Word DOCX for editable documents in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or LibreOffice. PDF export uses your browser print pipeline (Save as PDF) so output stays local when you convert client-side. HTML export keeps structure and rendered Mermaid diagrams where supported. DOCX export includes headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and Mermaid diagrams as images. Pick the format from the editor toolbar after you confirm the live preview looks right.
faq.a6: Yes. PDFWritter is a Markdown converter with built-in Mermaid diagram support. Add fenced mermaid code blocks for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, class diagrams, Gantt charts, and pie charts. Diagrams render in the live preview and are included when you export to PDF or HTML, which is the main difference versus many paste-only Markdown tools that drop diagrams or require a separate renderer. If a diagram type fails to render, share the Mermaid source with us at pdfwritter@gmail.com or on Reddit at u/pdfwritter.
faq.q7: Is PDFWritter the same as PDF Writer (pdfwriter.com)?
faq.a7: No. PDFWritter at pdfwritter.com is a free online Markdown to PDF converter with Mermaid diagrams and KaTeX math that runs in your browser. It is not the desktop PDF Writer software sold at pdfwriter.com. If you want to paste Markdown and download a PDF (with diagrams), use PDFWritter.

markdownToDocx.faq1Q: What is the Markdown to DOCX tool?
markdownToDocx.faq1A: It is a free online converter that turns Markdown into an editable Microsoft Word (.docx) document you can open in Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, and other word processors.
markdownToDocx.faq2Q: How do I convert Markdown to DOCX?
markdownToDocx.faq2A: Paste Markdown into the editor or upload a .md file, preview the rendered output, then click Download DOCX to save a Word document.
markdownToDocx.faq3Q: Does it support headings, lists, and tables?
markdownToDocx.faq3A: Yes. Headings, bullet and numbered lists, tables, blockquotes, links, inline formatting, and fenced code blocks are exported into the Word document.
markdownToDocx.faq4Q: Are Mermaid diagrams included in the DOCX file?
markdownToDocx.faq4A: Yes. Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams render in preview and are embedded as images in the exported .docx file when possible.
markdownToDocx.faq5Q: Is my Markdown uploaded to a server?
markdownToDocx.faq5A: No. Conversion runs in your browser, so your content stays private on your device.
markdownToDocx.faq6Q: Is this Markdown to DOCX converter free?
markdownToDocx.faq6A: Yes. PDFWritter is free online and does not require signup, installation, or watermarks.

markdownToTxt.whatTitle: What is this Markdown to TXT tool?
markdownToTxt.whatDescription: PDFWritter converts Markdown into clean plain text when you need readable content without Markdown syntax. It is useful for emails, support docs, content migration, notes, AI prompts, and any workflow where formatting markers get in the way.
markdownToTxt.howTitle: How to convert Markdown to TXT
markdownToTxt.howSubtitle: Strip Markdown formatting and download a plain-text file in seconds.
markdownToTxt.step1Desc: Add Markdown directly to the editor or upload a .md, .markdown, or .txt file.
markdownToTxt.step2Desc: Check the converted text for headings, lists, links, and code content before saving.
markdownToTxt.step3Desc: Export the result as a .txt file or copy it for email, notes, documentation, or publishing workflows.
markdownToTxt.featuresTitle: Features of the Markdown to TXT converter

markdownToTxt.feature2Desc: See TXT output instantly without waiting for an upload or server queue.
markdownToTxt.feature3Desc: Prepare Markdown content for email, support replies, text editors, CMS fields, and AI prompts.
markdownToTxt.feature4Desc: Drag and drop Markdown files and convert them directly in the browser.
markdownToTxt.feature5Desc: Copy the plain text or download a .txt file with one click.
markdownToTxt.feature6Desc: Use the converter free online with no signup, watermarks, or installation.
markdownToTxt.compareTitle: PDFWritter vs other Markdown to TXT converters
markdownToTxt.compare2Them: May upload files to a server
markdownToTxt.compare4Them: May add usage limits or account gates
markdownToTxt.mermaidDescription: TXT files cannot display diagrams visually, but Mermaid code blocks remain available as plain text so technical documentation can still be copied, searched, and reused.
markdownToTxt.faq1Q: What is the Markdown to TXT tool?
markdownToTxt.faq1A: It is a free online converter that strips Markdown formatting and exports clean plain text for notes, emails, support replies, and content reuse.
markdownToTxt.faq2Q: How do I convert Markdown to TXT?
markdownToTxt.faq2A: Paste Markdown or upload a .md file, preview the stripped plain-text output, then download the result as a .txt file.
markdownToTxt.faq3A: Yes. The converter removes formatting markers such as heading symbols, links, emphasis syntax, and code fences where plain text is more useful.
markdownToTxt.faq4Q: Does Mermaid content work in TXT export?
markdownToTxt.faq4A: Mermaid diagrams are text-based code blocks, so the source remains available as plain text even though TXT cannot visually render diagrams.
markdownToTxt.faq5Q: Is the Markdown to TXT converter private?
markdownToTxt.faq5A: Yes. Conversion happens in your browser, so your file content stays on your device.
